ns2:course.label: Intermediate Quechua I
ns2:course.description: Intensive course for intermediate-level Quechua. Emphasis on oral and written production and comprehension skills. 3 undergraduate hours. 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: QUEC 411 or consent of instructor.
